jobs.prompt: Owner board request 3 says the project CARD line must read 'build D/T · human d/t' (percent and build counts from non-human tickets; human separate; with no human tickets just 'build D/T'), replacing today's '66% · Building · ETA 8d' mismatch. tools/build-progress.mjs progressSummary already computes `headline`, but it is not an enumerable own property, so it is lost when the board snapshot is JSON-serialized and the card never sees it; also tools/watch-assets/board.js progressLine still renders '<overall>% · <current> · ETA Nd'. Fix: (1) progressSummary returns a plain object with `headline` (and `untracked` counts: { runs, jobs }) as ordinary enumerable fields, plus the existing fields; (2) board.js progressLine renders: meter(overall) + text `headline` + ' · ' + current milestone + (eta ? ' · ETA ' + eta + 'd' : '') + (untracked runs ? ' · untracked work: ' + N + ' runs' with a warn style : ''); textContent only. Tests: in tests/build-progress-atlas.test.mjs (or tests/board-page.test.mjs) assert JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(progressSummary(p))).headline === the exact atlas header, and that a no-human ledger gives 'build N/N'. Edit only tools/build-progress.mjs, tools/watch-assets/board.js and tests/build-progress-atlas.test.mjs. Do NOT touch tools/swarm.mjs. Run `node --import ./tests/_isolate-config.mjs --test tests/build-progress-atlas.test.mjs tests/build-progress.test.mjs tests/board-page.test.mjs tests/board-projects-filter.test.mjs` and `node tools/check-package.mjs`.
